data.name: S_RemoteControl_Enabled_D
data.value: This switch belongs to this device alone; while it is off no command from the service is executed

data.name: S_RemoteControl_GroupId_D
data.value: Provided by the console once the group exists; a node must be registered in that group first or the connection is refused

data.name: S_RemoteControl_ServerUrl_D
data.value: Defaults to the online node channel; plaintext ws connections are allowed only to loopback

data.name: S_RemoteControl_NodeId_D
data.value: Generated at install time and kept stable; use it to register this node in the console

data.name: S_RemoteControl_DisplayName_D
data.value: The name shown for this machine in the console node list; leave it empty to report the host name

data.name: S_RemoteControl_Status_D
data.value: Reconnects with backoff after a drop; failures that retrying cannot fix wait here until the configuration is corrected

data.name: S_RemoteControl_DrawLocked_D
data.value: Set from the console; while locked this device refuses to draw

data.name: M_EndpointRejected
data.value: The node channel URL is invalid, so it was not saved

data.name: M_Status_Idle
data.value: Waiting for sign-in or a group ID

data.name: M_Detail_NotConfigured
data.value: No group ID has been entered yet

data.name: M_Detail_NotSignedIn
data.value: Not signed in to a SECTL account

data.name: M_Detail_NodeNotFound
data.value: This group has no such node; register it in the console first

data.name: M_Detail_GroupNotFound
data.value: The group does not exist, or this account is not a member of it

data.name: M_Detail_InvalidRequest
data.value: Malformed request, which is a client problem

data.name: M_Detail_Unauthorized
data.value: The service rejected this node credential; check that the node channel accepts bearer tokens from this platform

data.name: M_Detail_EndpointInvalid
data.value: The node channel URL is invalid

data.name: S_ControlPlaneEndpoint_D
data.value: Base URL the console uses to reach the control plane; leave it empty to fall back to the online default address

data.name: M_ControlPlaneEndpointRejected
data.value: The control plane URL is invalid and was not saved; use https, and plaintext http only for a loopback address

data.value: Opens the control platform web console in your browser to manage the devices in this group
